messages:
Marta: Quick q — drafting a short checklist for running replay harnesses on prod traces for kernel-selection apples-to-apples. Need recommended anonymization flow, sampling slices, determinism knobs, and parity checks. Who can share notes? :mag_right:

Jon S: +1. We ran a full kernel-suite last week. Essentials: deterministic RNG seed, frozen model weights, and pinned CUDA/cuBLAS/toolkit versions. Also pin quantization path and env vars.

Samir: Important: KV cache state. For parity you need two explicit modes: 'replay-with-cache' and 'replay-cold-start'. Compare both latency/token and output similarity.

Yvonne: For anonymization we hash user IDs and preserve conversation structure. Use redact-proto v2 to strip PII but keep tokenization boundaries. Example: `tools/anon/redact_v2.py --keep-ids-hash --preserve-turns`.

Jon S: Sampling: stratify by sequence-length buckets (short <50, mid 50-512, long >512) and by per-session token-rate (p50/p95). Use reservoir sampling per bucket. We used ~10k sessions per bucket for stable latency estimates.

Marta: Any run commands or examples I can paste into the checklist? (cc @replay-bot)

replay-bot: Command accepted. Example run:
```
./scripts/replay_run \  --trace traces/anon/2026-11-02.json \  --seed 42 \  --mode compare \  --kernels l2,l3,l4 \  --output results/2026-11-02-kernel-compare.json
```
Started job replay-1799123456-1.

Samir: Also capture per-token perf counters and NVTX ranges. Log fields: kernel_name, seq_len, batch_size, kv_hit_rate, avg_latency_ms, tokens_generated.

Kai: Determinism knobs: set `REPLAY_DETERMINISTIC=1`, `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`, fix cuBLAS config, and pin driver/runtime. Note: fp16/fp32 nondeterminism can still crop up. Use cosine similarity on logits and normalized edit-distance on outputs. We accept small diffs: logits_cos_sim > 0.999 and nedit < 3 on 95% samples for sanity.

Yvonne: Parity check rules we used: emit a `diff-summary.csv` with columns [kernel_a,kernel_b,seq_bucket,median_latency_ratio,logits_cos_sim_p95,nedit_p95,kv_cache_diff_rate]. Fail the run if median_latency_ratio >1.15 or logits_cos_sim_p95 <0.995. Adjust thresholds per workload.

Marta: For anonymization audit — how do we detect sampling bias introduced by redaction? Don't want to over-index on short sessions.

Jon S: Add a post-sampling QC step: compare original trace distribution vs sampled distribution on dimensions {seq_len, active_user_days, client_type}. If KL divergence > 0.05 on any dimension, re-sample. We log the KL numbers in run metadata.

Samir: Note from previous regression: changing the batcher heuristic (timeout) reduced micro-batching and hurt GPU occupancy on long sequences. Quick test: run `--replay-window 250` vs `--replay-window 50` to see impact on throughput.

replay-bot: Job replay-1799123456-1 completed. Summary: kernels l2 vs l3 -> median_latency_ratio=1.08, logits_cos_sim_p95=0.998, nedit_p95=1. Artifacts: results/2026-11-02-kernel-compare.json, results/diff-summary.csv.

Marta: Great, thanks all. I'll draft the checklist and add a small CI gate that runs the parity checks for dedicated perf branches. If anyone wants to propose threshold tweaks or sample sizes, drop them inline here or open a PR against infra/playbooks/replay_checklist.md :thumbsup:
